notes.title: Illusion of Being Update - 7/31/23
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

We have a few announcements to make as the month of July closes out, hope you enjoy!

Summer's not over yet and Cinthia is keeping things hot!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43622902/4485307a07f9219b73a62ff96ef38c2ebbf0b8ff.jpg

We are excited to share that Chapter 1 is complete and uploaded to Steam for their review! 

We are hopeful that it will be available the day of the expected launch (August 11th) but that is up to Steam now.

The demo has been removed from the Steam store.  

We believe it no longer accurately represents IOB Chapter 1, due to how the game features much more content and story line now.

The new release trailer is now on the store page!

Also, the store page has been further updated to better reflect Chapter 1 as well as our vision for the project as a whole.

Stay in touch with the latest from the developers!

Our discussion boards will be an excellent way to begin communicating with us as future Chapter development pushes forward.  However most of our engagement with the community is through our discord and you will find a lot more content there.

Click here to join our discord!

Hope to see you soon!

-TEG

notes.title: Illusion of Being Update - 7/5/23
notes.content:
Hello everyone!  

We wanted to drop in and give a small update on the games progress.

We've been chugging along towards the final scenes and completing animations for the.. climax.. of the story this past month!

The only thing hotter than summer is the content being worked on by our wonderful art department.

Click here to join Discord!

Until next time!

notes.title: Illusion of Being Update - 6/15/23
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43622902/f9b4928fc95da400695f5caf2a135e1a70a7d65d.jpg

Hello Everyone,

As we are approaching ever closer to the release of Chapter 1, it is imperative to us to deliver the most immersive and polished experience we can for you to enjoy.

Many aspects of this production have changed on an art and programming level as the game has progressed. These changes bring better overall visuals, more immersive game play elements, and more.

Due to this, you will notice a decent change in how things look and feel after the "Confrontation Scene" that was at the end of the demo. Branch text, lighting, and LOD being the things that will jump out at you the most.

Animation has also been decently overhauled to bring an even more immerse H-Scene experience.
As you can imagine, taking on the extra workload proved to take more time than expected. 

Chapter 1 is pretty much complete as far as being put together, we would say around 90%. 

Now we need to iron out any bugs and polish the player's experience to a level that will meet our expectations for you. 

With this said, the project release of Chapter 1 will experience a short delay. Our current production schedule expects a polished finished product to release on the date of August 11th, 2023.

Another element to this delay is the Art Designer of our project. They have a heart condition that unfortunately can make them very ill for a week or two at a time. The condition is intermittent and has affected them off and on throughout this production. Never the less, when they are able to work, they are doing the best they can to deliver you all a solid experience for when you get to enjoy Illusion of Being's first chapter.

We would like to say thank you all for you time and we wish you a wonderful day!

Regards,
The TEG Team
